# Whether plants stay with every block state in a place beyond the block below them, as both official servers decide
# it (harness 0.25.0 plant context report): sugar cane on the state with a water source beside it (cane_ground), on
# sand with the state beside the sand (cane_water); a cactus on sand with the state beside it (cactus_side) and above it
# (cactus_above); brown and red mushrooms on the state at light 0 (brown_dark, red_dark; in a stone box whose light
# settled first, so the light of states that emit it is not certain to be seen); a small dripleaf's lower half on the
# state in a water source (dripleaf_wet). One code per column, 1 or 0, ? when the state did not stay where it was set,
# - when the version lacks the plant. A bare block name stands for all its states.
# Columns: cane_ground cane_water cactus_side cactus_above brown_dark red_dark dripleaf_wet
# Java Edition 1.21.4: the states whose codes plant-contexts-1.21.8.txt does not give; every other state as there.
